terrainDescription.zh: 地峽地形狹長，巴拿馬運河橫貫其間，兩側太平洋與加勒比海皆有海岸線，東部達連省是中美洲最大片未開發熱帶雨林。
terrainDescription.en: A narrow isthmus bisected by the Panama Canal, with coastline on both the Pacific and Caribbean; the eastern Darién province holds Central America's largest expanse of undeveloped rainforest.

historicalContext.zh: 官方語言為西班牙語，境內有多個原住民自治區（如恩格貝、庫納）保有自身語言；巴拿馬不使用中美洲共通的區域標誌手冊，而是自成一套系統，但因巴拿馬運河區歷史上長期由美國管理，道路標誌設計仍深受美式 MUTCD 影響，距離以公里計算。
historicalContext.en: Spanish is official, with several indigenous comarcas (autonomous territories, e.g. Ngäbe-Buglé, Guna Yala) retaining their own languages. Panama doesn't follow the shared Central American regional sign manual, running its own separate system instead — but decades of US administration of the Panama Canal Zone left it heavily MUTCD-influenced in practice, with distances in kilometers.
